Chapter 1 — United Airlines Flight 232

44 Minutes Without Control

1989.07.19 DENVER → CHICAGO

This game is based on the crash of United Airlines Flight 232 on July 19, 1989. Of the 296 people on board, 112 died.

It was made to honor those who died, and to learn and think about what happened and what saved people. The main character and some of the people and conversations are fictional. Times, numbers and cockpit words are based on the accident investigation report and Wikipedia.

Some scenes involve the impact of the aircraft, smoke, and the number of people who died. If you have been through a painful experience in an accident or disaster, please do not push yourself.
